title: Teacher and Traitor
summary: Xiao Yan draws the Fallen Heart Flame's core toward his body, and Han Feng offers him a sixth-tier prescription to give it up, then fights him for it with his Sea Heart Flame. When Xiao Yan reveals he practises the complete Flame Mantra, Yao Lao shows himself, and Han Feng learns his old master is still alive inside Xiao Yan. Han Feng uses his Sea Flame Trident, but Xiao Yan's Angry Buddha Lotus Flame blasts him into a coma, and his allies carry him off. The Fallen Heart Flame then feeds on the blast and turns on Xiao Yan. Su Qian orders the Eight-Way Dragon Binding Formation, and Xiao Yan stays inside as bait until the flame swallows him and the elders seal it. Su Qian closes the tower's lowest floor for good and honours Xiao Yan as the academy's finest student.
